name: Dark Vengeance
source: This is the story of Holly and her best friend Brooke. These girls have decided to spend the summer on a private island owned by Holly’s boyfriend Nathan, they were going to spend the summer of their lives, but suddenly everything was cut short with the appearance of some thieves who decided to take advantage of the opportunity to see two beautiful girls alone in the house.
